title: Measures to combat infectious disease in tsarist Russia
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.answer: ii — Systematic intelligence-gathering about external cases of plague
questions.answerKey: ii — Systematic intelligence-gathering about external cases of plague
questions.translation: 找出 A 段整段主旨。

blocks.text: 題目要求：為 Section A 選最合適 heading。
Matching Headings。Heading 題要看整段反覆處理的核心，不要只抓一個細節。這
段最明顯的重複概念是 information、reported、commercial channels、military personnel、undercover agents、embassies、customs offices。
目標段落：Section A
第一句：

“In the second half of the seventeenth century, Russian authorities began implementing controls at the borders of their empire to prevent the importation of plague, a highly infectious and dangerous disease.”
中文意思：在十七世紀下半葉，俄羅斯當局開始在帝國邊境實施管制，以防止鼠疫這種高度傳染
和危險的疾病輸入。
最後一句：
“For instance, the heads of customs offices were instructed to question foreigners entering Russia about possible epidemics of dangerous diseases in their respective countries.”
中文意思：例如，海關主管被指示要詢問進入俄羅斯的外國人，了解他們各自國家是否可能有危
險疾病流行。
只看首尾句，A 段先講邊境管制目的，最後講海關詢問外國人疫情情況。中間應會解釋俄羅斯如何知道外國是否有疫情。
題目 heading ii 的定位詞是 “intelligence-gathering” 和 “external cases”。原文沒有
intelligence-gathering 這個詞，但有 “Information on disease outbreaks occurring abroad was regularly reported”。external cases = outbreaks occurring abroad。
關鍵句是：
“Information on disease outbreaks occurring abroad was regularly reported to the tsar’s court through various means...”
中文意思：發生在國外的疾病爆發資訊，會透過不同方式定期報告到沙皇宮廷。

後面列出的方式包括 travelling merchants、military personnel deployed abroad、undercover agents、Imperial Foreign Office embassies、customs offices。這些渠道合起來就是 systematic intelligence-gathering。heading ii 覆蓋整段，因為它不只包含密探，也包含外交、軍事、商業和海關渠道。
錯項方面，iii “Early forms of treatment” 完全沒有治療內容；v “bans against foreign states” 更適合 B 段，因為 B 段才講 suspend relations、vessels not allowed to dock、quarantine。A 段的重點是外國疫情資訊如何被收集和上報。
所以答案是 ii。

questions.answer: v — Partly successful bans against foreign states affected by plague
questions.answerKey: v — Partly successful bans against foreign states affected by plague
questions.translation: 判斷 B 段主要內容。

blocks.text: 題目要求：為 Section B 選最合適 heading。
Matching Headings。這段有很多防疫措施，但整段最突出的主線是：收到外國疫情
消息後，俄羅斯限制與受影響國家的接觸，並且短期看來有效。
目標段落：Section B
第一句：
“If news of an outbreak came from abroad, relations with the affected country were suspended.”
中文意思：如果從國外傳來疫情爆發的消息，俄羅斯就會中止與受影響國家的關係。
最後一句：

“By the end of the seventeenth century, preventive measures had been widely introduced in Russia, including the isolation of persons ill with plague, the imposition of quarantines, and the distribution of explanatory public health notices about plague outbreaks.”
中文意思：到十七世紀末，俄羅斯已廣泛引入預防措施，包括隔離鼠疫病人、實施檢疫，以及發布
解釋鼠疫爆發情況的公共衛生告示。
只看首尾句，可以知道本段從中止對外關係開始，收束到十七世紀末預防措施普及。中間會有具體禁令和效果例子。
heading v 的關鍵是 “bans”、“foreign states affected by plague” 和 “partly successful”。原
文對應包括 “relations ... were suspended”、“foreign vessels were not allowed to dock”、“all foreigners ... had to undergo quarantine”，以及 “appeared to have been effective”。
關鍵證據：
“For instance, foreign vessels were not allowed to dock in Russian ports if there was credible information about the existence of epidemics in countries from whence they had departed.”
中文意思：例如，如果有可信資料顯示船隻出發國有疫情，外國船隻就不得停靠俄羅斯港口。
“In 1665 ... Tsar Alexei ... announced the cessation of Russian trade relations with England and other foreign states.”
中文意思：1665 年，在收到英國鼠疫消息後，沙皇 Alexei 宣布中止俄羅斯與英國及其他外國的
貿易關係。
“These protective measures appeared to have been effective...”
中文意思：這些保護措施看來有效。

“appeared to have been effective” 支援 heading 中的 successful；但後文又提 1692 年Astrakhan 爆發鼠疫，所以 heading 用 “partly successful” 很精準，表示措施有成效，但未能永久阻止鼠疫再出現。錯項 vi “Hostile reactions from foreign states” 沒有原文支援；B 段只說俄羅斯中止關係，沒有說外國抗議或敵對反應。viii “formulation and publication of preventive strategies” 更適合 F 段的decrees 和 Instructions。所以答案是 v。

questions.answer: i — Outbreaks of plague resulting from military campaigns
questions.answerKey: i — Outbreaks of plague resulting from military campaigns

blocks.text: 題目要求：為 Section C 選 heading。
Matching Headings。這段表面有很多地名和年份，但主線是十八世紀鼠疫如何在戰
爭和軍事部署中出現，並造成俄軍重大損失。
目標段落：Section C
第一句：
“During the eighteenth century, although none of the outbreaks was of the same scale as in the past, plague appeared in Russia several times.”
中文意思：十八世紀期間，雖然沒有任何一次疫情達到過去那種規模，鼠疫仍數次出現在俄羅
斯。
最後一句：
“Russian military chronicles of the time note that more soldiers died of the disease after the capture of Riga than from enemy fire during the siege of that city.”
中文意思：當時俄羅斯軍事編年史記載，在攻佔 Riga 後，死於疾病的士兵多於在圍城期間死於
敵方炮火的士兵。
首句帶出十八世紀疫情多次出現，末句聚焦軍隊死亡。這提示 C 段的重心會落在 plague 和military campaigns 的關係。
heading i 的定位詞是 “military campaigns”。原文出現 battle of Poltava、dispatched part of
his army、Russian troops、besieged Riga、Russian army lost 9,800 soldiers。這些都是軍事語義場。
關鍵句包括：
“After defeating the Swedes in the battle of Poltava in 1709, Tsar Peter I ... dispatched part of his army to Poland, where plague had been raging for two years.”
中文意思：1709 年在 Poltava 戰役擊敗瑞典人後，Peter I 派出部分軍隊前往波蘭，而鼠疫已在波
蘭肆虐兩年。
“Despite preventive measures, the disease spread among the Russian troops.”
中文意思：儘管有預防措施，疾病仍在俄軍中傳播。
“...the Russian army lost 9,800 soldiers to the plague.”
中文意思：俄軍有 9,800 名士兵死於鼠疫。
這些句子說明疫情和軍隊移動、圍城、戰爭部署密切相連。heading i 用 “resulting from military campaigns” 概括這一段最貼切。
錯項 vii 也有 “war”，但它說的是 “Various measures to limit outbreaks”，更像 D 段，因為 D 段列出隔離、軍營分隔、封鎖和路障。C 段重點在 outbreak 和 casualties。
所以答案是 i。

questions.answer: vii — Various measures to limit outbreaks of plague associated with war
questions.answerKey: vii — Various measures to limit outbreaks of plague associated with war

blocks.text: 題目要求：為 Section D 選 heading。
Matching Headings。D 段和 C 段都涉及戰爭，所以要分清：C 段講戰事導致或伴隨
疫情；D 段講如何在戰事中限制疫情。
目標段落：Section D
第一句：
“Tsar Peter I imposed strict measures to prevent the spread of plague during these conflicts.”
中文意思：Peter I 在這些衝突期間實施嚴格措施，以防止鼠疫擴散。
最後一句：
“The tsar’s orders were rigorously enforced, and those who disobeyed were hanged.”
中文意思：沙皇的命令被嚴格執行，違令者會被絞死。
首句已經直接說 strict measures to prevent the spread；末句說執行非常嚴厲。這段功能明顯是列舉戰時防疫措施。
heading vii 的定位詞是 “measures”、“limit outbreaks” 和 “war”。原文對應 “imposed strict
measures”、“isolated”、“separate divisions”、“cordon off”、“roadblocks and checkpoints”。
關鍵證據：
“Soldiers suspected of being infected were isolated and taken to areas far from military camps.”
中文意思：疑似感染的士兵會被隔離，並帶到遠離軍營的地方。
“In addition, camps were designed to separate divisions, detachments, and smaller units of soldiers.”
中文意思：此外，軍營設計會分隔師、支隊和較小士兵單位。
“...roadblocks and checkpoints were set up on all roads.”
中文意思：所有道路都設置路障和檢查站。
這些措施共同目的都是限制人員與物資流動，減低戰爭期間鼠疫擴散。heading vii 的 “various measures” 能覆蓋隔離、軍營設計、河界封鎖、暫停活動、路障和檢查站。
錯項 i 與軍事有關，但 i 更重在 outbreaks caused by campaigns；D 段核心是 prevention and control。iv “general limitations” 要到 E 段，因為 E 段以 However 開始評估措施缺陷。
所以答案是 vii。

questions.answer: iv — The general limitations of early Russian anti-plague measures
questions.answerKey: iv — The general limitations of early Russian anti-plague measures
questions.translation: 找出 E 段整體功能。

blocks.text: 題目要求：為 Section E 選 heading。
Matching Headings。E 段很短，轉折詞 However 是主旨訊號。這段不再列新措施，
焦點轉向早期措施的不足。
目標段落：Section E
第一句：
“However, although the Russian authorities applied such methods to contain the spread of the disease and limit the number of victims, all of the measures were provisional...”
中文意思：然而，雖然俄羅斯當局使用這些方法控制疾病傳播並限制受害者人數，但所有措施都
只是臨時性的。
最後一句：
“The advent of such a standard response system came a few years later.”
中文意思：這種標準應對系統的出現，要到數年後才發生。
首句講 provisional，末句講 standard response system 後來才出現。這組首尾句清楚顯示：前面的措施有用，但缺乏標準化、系統化。
heading iv 的定位詞是 “limitations” 和 “early measures”。原文對應 “all of the measures
were provisional”、“not designed as a coherent set of measures”、“implemented systematically”。
關鍵句：
“...they were intended to respond to a specific outbreak, and were not designed as a coherent set of measures to be implemented systematically at the first sign of plague.”
中文意思：這些措施旨在回應某一次具體疫情，並沒有被設計成一套連貫措施，能在鼠疫初現時
系統地執行。
這句直接說明 limitations：措施只針對單次疫情，缺乏 coherence 和 systematic implementation。
heading iv 的 “general limitations” 正好概括此段。
錯項 viii “formulation and publication of preventive strategies” 看似也有 standard response system，但 E 段說這套系統還未出現。真正 formulation 在 F 段，因為 F 段講 issued several decrees 和 Instructions。
所以答案是 iv。

questions.answer: viii — The formulation and publication of preventive strategies
questions.answerKey: viii — The formulation and publication of preventive strategies

blocks.text: 題目要求：為 Section F 選 heading。
Matching Headings。F 段是全文中最長的一段，列出具體法令和程序。Heading 要
能覆蓋整段，不可只抓 burn houses 或 heat letters 等細節。
目標段落：Section F
第一句：
“The first attempts to organise procedures and carry out proactive steps to control plague date from the aftermath of the 1727–1728 epidemic in Astrakhan.”
中文意思：組織程序並採取主動措施控制鼠疫的初步嘗試，始於 1727–1728 年 Astrakhan 疫情
之後。
最後一句：
“Finally, letters brought by couriers were heated above a fire before being copied.”
中文意思：最後，由信使帶來的信件要先在火上加熱，再被抄寫。
首句已經顯示程序化和主動防控；末句是其中一項具體程序。整段會列出官方策略的內容。
heading viii 的定位詞是 “formulation”、“publication” 和 “preventive strategies”。原文對應
“issued several decrees”、“Instructions for Governors and Heads of Townships”、“required that...”。
關鍵證據：
“In response to this, the Russian imperial authorities issued several decrees aimed at controlling the future spread of plague.”
中文意思：作為回應，俄羅斯帝國當局發布了幾項法令，目的在於控制日後鼠疫的傳播。
“Among these decrees, the ‘Instructions for Governors and Heads of Townships’ required that all governors immediately inform the Senate...”
中文意思：在這些法令中，《給省長和城鎮主管的指示》要求所有省長在各自省份發現鼠疫病例時
，立即通知 Senate。
接著原文列出檢查、隔離、檢查站、焚燒房屋財物、通知鄰近省市、加熱信件等程序。這些都屬於preventive strategies 的具體內容。heading viii 最能概括整段。
錯項 iii “treatment for plague victims” 不合適，因為 F 段重點是通報、隔離、封鎖和處理物品，沒有講醫療治療。iv 則是 E 段的限制評估。
所以答案是 viii。

questions.answer: B — Spying；D — Restrictions on access to its ports
questions.answerKey: B — Spying；D — Restrictions on access to its ports
questions.translation: 十七世紀俄羅斯採取哪兩項措施避免鼠疫爆發？

blocks.text: 題目問：Which TWO measures did Russia take in the seventeenth century to avoid plague outbreaks?
Choose TWO。每個答案都要有獨立原文支援。控制詞是 “seventeenth century” 和
“avoid plague outbreaks”，所以目標段落主要是 A 和 B。
目標段落：Sections A–B
Section A 第一句：“In the second half of the seventeenth century, Russian authorities began implementing controls at the borders of their empire...”
中文意思：十七世紀下半葉，俄羅斯當局開始在帝國邊境實施管制。
Section B 第一句：
“If news of an outbreak came from abroad, relations with the affected country were suspended.”
中文意思：如果外國傳來疫情爆發消息，俄羅斯就會中止與受影響國家的關係。
只看這兩段首句，已可判斷 seventeenth century 的措施包括情報收集和邊境限制。
選項 B “Spying” 對應 Section A 的 “undercover agents”。選項 D “Restrictions on access
to its ports” 對應 Section B 的 “foreign vessels were not allowed to dock in Russian ports”。
B 的證據：
“Information on disease outbreaks occurring abroad was regularly reported to the tsar’s court through various means, including ... undercover agents...”
中文意思：國外疾病爆發資訊會透過多種方式定期報告到沙皇宮廷，其中包括密探。
undercover agents 即秘密代理人，可概括為 spying。這是俄羅斯掌握外國疫情消息的一種方式。
D 的證據：
“...foreign vessels were not allowed to dock in Russian ports if there was credible information about the existence of epidemics...”
中文意思：如果有可信資料顯示某國存在疫情，來自該國的外國船隻不得停靠俄羅斯港口。
not allowed to dock = restrictions on access to ports。
錯項分析： A “Cooperation with foreign leaders” 不成立。Tsar Alexei 寫信給 Charles II 是通知停止貿易關係，語氣功能是宣告限制，未顯示合作防疫。
C “Military campaigns” 屬於後文十八世紀戰爭背景，且軍事行動反而帶來疫情風險。
E “Expulsion of foreigners” 不成立；原文說 foreigners had to undergo quarantine，即檢疫，沒有驅逐。
所以答案是 B 和 D。

questions.answer: A — Plague outbreaks were consistently smaller than before；E — Anti-plague measures
questions.answerKey: A — Plague outbreaks were consistently smaller than before；E — Anti-plague measures
questions.translation: 關於十八世紀早期的俄羅斯，文章提出了哪兩個說法？

blocks.text: were generally reactive rather than strategic題目問：Which TWO statements are made about Russia in the early eighteenth century?
Choose TWO。控制詞是 early eighteenth century，所以主要看 C、D、E。這題要把
「疫情規模」、「Riga 傷亡」、「軍營設計」、「St Petersburg 防護」和「措施性質」逐一對照原文。
目標段落：Sections C–E
Section C 第一句：
“During the eighteenth century, although none of the outbreaks was of the same scale as in the past, plague appeared in Russia several times.”
中文意思：十八世紀期間，雖然沒有任何一次疫情達到過去那種規模，鼠疫仍數次出現在俄羅
斯。
Section E 第一句：
“However ... all of the measures were provisional...”
中文意思：然而，所有措施都只是臨時性的。
只看 C 和 E 的首句，A 和 E 已有很強支援。
A 的定位詞是 “smaller than before”，原文對應 “none ... was of the same scale as in the
past”。E 的定位詞是 “reactive rather than strategic”，原文對應 “respond to a specific outbreak”和 “not designed as a coherent set”。
A 的證據：
“During the eighteenth century, although none of the outbreaks was of the same scale as in the past, plague appeared in Russia several times.”
中文意思：十八世紀期間，雖然沒有任何一次疫情達到過去那種規模，鼠疫仍數次出現在俄羅
斯。
none ... same scale as in the past = outbreaks were smaller than before。題目用 “consistently”概括 none 的範圍。
E 的證據：
“...they were intended to respond to a specific outbreak, and were not designed as a coherent set of measures to be implemented systematically at the first sign of plague.”
中文意思：這些措施旨在回應某一次具體疫情，並沒有被設計成一套連貫措施，能在鼠疫初現時
系統執行。
respond to a specific outbreak = reactive。not designed as a coherent set / systematically = not strategic。
錯項分析： B 說 Riga 的軍事傷亡超過鼠疫死者。原文說死於疾病的士兵多於死於敵火的士兵，方向相反。
C 說軍營設計使鼠疫快速擴散。原文說 camps were designed to separate units，目的是減少傳播。
D 說保護 St Petersburg 的計劃沒有嚴格執行。原文說 orders were rigorously enforced，直接相反。
所以答案是 A 和 E。

questions.prompt: “An outbreak of plague in __________ prompted the publication of a coherent preventive strategy.”
questions.translation: 在甚麼地方爆發的鼠疫，促使一套連貫的預防策略被發布？

blocks.text: Sentence Completion。限制是 ONE WORD ONLY，所以答案必須是一個字。空格前
是 “in”，要填地名。
目標段落：Section F
第一句：
“The first attempts to organise procedures and carry out proactive steps to control plague date from the aftermath of the 1727–1728 epidemic in Astrakhan.”
中文意思：組織程序並採取主動措施控制鼠疫的初步嘗試，始於 1727–1728 年 Astrakhan 疫情
之後。
最後一句：
“Finally, letters brought by couriers were heated above a fire before being copied.”
中文意思：最後，由信使帶來的信件要先在火上加熱，再被抄寫。
首句直接包含 outbreak 的地點和後續程序化防疫措施，因此 F 段是目標段落。
題目定位詞是 “outbreak of plague”、“prompted”、“coherent preventive strategy”。原文對應
“aftermath of the 1727–1728 epidemic in Astrakhan” 和 “issued several decrees aimed at controlling the future spread of plague”。
關鍵證據：
“The first attempts to organise procedures and carry out proactive steps to control plague date from the aftermath of the 1727–1728 epidemic in Astrakhan.”
中文意思：組織程序並採取主動控制鼠疫步驟的初步嘗試，始於 1727–1728 年 Astrakhan 疫情
之後。
下一句補充：
“In response to this, the Russian imperial authorities issued several decrees aimed at controlling the future spread of plague.”
中文意思：作為回應，俄羅斯帝國當局發布了幾項法令，目的在於控制日後鼠疫傳播。
題目的 “prompted the publication of a coherent preventive strategy” 概括了 “In response to this... issued several decrees”。空格問地點，答案就是 Astrakhan。
答案形式： Astrakhan 是一個字，符合 ONE WORD ONLY。
所以答案是 Astrakhan。

questions.prompt: “Provincial governors were ordered to burn the __________ and possessions of plague victims.”
questions.translation: 省長被命令焚燒鼠疫受害者的甚麼和財物？

blocks.text: Sentence Completion。限制是 ONE WORD ONLY。空格前有 “the”，後面有 “and
possessions”，所以要填一個名詞，與 possessions 並列。
目標段落：Section F
第一句：
“The first attempts to organise procedures and carry out proactive steps to control plague date from the aftermath of the 1727–1728 epidemic in Astrakhan.”
中文意思：組織程序並採取主動控制鼠疫步驟的初步嘗試，始於 1727–1728 年 Astrakhan 疫情
之後。
最後一句：
“Finally, letters brought by couriers were heated above a fire before being copied.”
中文意思：最後，由信使帶來的信件要先在火上加熱，再被抄寫。
F 段列出正式防疫程序，其中包括處理感染者住所和物品。題目問 governors ordered，所以要看F 段 decree 內容。
定位詞是 “governors”、“burn”、“possessions”。原文直接有 “governors were instructed” 和
“The houses of infected persons were to be burned...”。
關鍵句：
“The houses of infected persons were to be burned along with all of the personal property they contained, including farm animals and cattle.”
中文意思：感染者的房屋要被焚燒，連同房屋內所有個人財產，包括農場動物和牛隻。
題目中的 plague victims 對應 infected persons；possessions 對應 personal property；burn the______ 對應 houses were to be burned。
答案形式： houses 是一個字，符合 ONE WORD ONLY。
不要填 “personal property”，因為題目已有 possessions，空格要填與 possessions 並列的對象。
所以答案是 houses。

questions.prompt: “Correspondence was held over a __________ before it was copied.”
questions.translation: 信件在被抄寫前，會被放在甚麼上方？

blocks.text: Sentence Completion。限制是 ONE WORD ONLY。空格前是 “over a”，所以答案應
該是一個單數名詞。題目中的 correspondence 是 letters 的概括。
目標段落：Section F
第一句：
“The first attempts to organise procedures and carry out proactive steps to control plague date from the aftermath of the 1727–1728 epidemic in Astrakhan.”
中文意思：組織程序並採取主動控制鼠疫步驟的初步嘗試，始於 1727–1728 年 Astrakhan 疫情
之後。
最後一句：
“Finally, letters brought by couriers were heated above a fire before being copied.”
中文意思：最後，由信使帶來的信件要先在火上加熱，再被抄寫。
最後一句已直接對應題目。
定位詞是 “Correspondence”、“held over”、“copied”。原文用 “letters”、“heated above” 和
“before being copied”。 Correspondence = letters held over = heated above before it was copied = before being copied
關鍵句：
“Finally, letters brought by couriers were heated above a fire before being copied.”
中文意思：最後，由信使帶來的信件要先在火上加熱，再被抄寫。
題目把 letters 改成 correspondence，意思是信件或通信材料；把 heated above 改成 held over，仍然指在火上處理。空格要填 fire。
答案形式： fire 是一個字，符合 ONE WORD ONLY。
所以答案是 fire。

paragraphOverview.title: Step 1：全文 Skim Roadmap
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: A 段首句說，十七世紀下半葉，俄羅斯當局開始在帝國邊境設置管制，防止鼠疫輸入。末句提到海關主管要詢問入境外國人，其國家是否有危險疾病流行。只看首尾句，可以先判斷本段主題是「從外部收集疫情情報」。中間列出商人、海外軍人、密探、外交網絡和海關，說明俄羅斯已有多渠道監察外國疫情的制度。
paragraphs.label: Section A

paragraphs.summary: B 段首句說，一旦外國傳來疫情消息，俄羅斯會中止與受影響國家的關係。末句說到十七世紀末，俄羅斯已廣泛採用多種預防措施，包括隔離病人、實施檢疫和發布公共衛生告示。只看首尾句，可以知道本段重點是俄羅斯面對外國疫情時的邊境限制、港口禁令、檢疫和貿易中止。段中 1665年英國疫情例子會支援「部分成功」的防疫禁令。
paragraphs.label: Section B

paragraphs.summary: C 段首句說，十八世紀期間，雖然疫情規模不及過去，鼠疫仍數次出現在俄羅斯。末句說俄羅斯軍事編年史記載，佔領 Riga 後死於疾病的士兵多於圍城期間死於敵火的士兵。只看首尾句，可以估計本段集中講十八世紀鼠疫爆發，尤其與軍事行動、波蘭、Riga 圍城和俄軍傷亡有關。題目若提 early eighteenth century、military campaigns 或 Riga，應定位此段。
paragraphs.label: Section C

paragraphs.summary: D 段首句說 Tsar Peter I 在這些衝突期間實施嚴格措施，以防止鼠疫擴散。末句說沙皇命令被嚴格執行，違令者會被絞死。首尾句顯示本段重點是戰爭相關疫情的控制措施。中間包括隔離疑似感染士兵、分隔軍營單位、封鎖 Luga River 邊界、暫停河上活動、設置路障和檢查站。題目若問戰時防疫措施，D 段最重要。
paragraphs.label: Section D

paragraphs.summary: E 段首句以 However 開始，指出俄羅斯當局雖然使用方法控制疾病和減少受害者，但所有措施都只是 provisional。末句說標準化應對系統數年後才出現。只看首尾句，可以判斷本段是對早期措施的限制作總結：措施能應付特定疫情，卻缺乏一套在鼠疫初現時即可系統執行的 coherent response。Heading 題若問 limitations，應看此段。
paragraphs.label: Section E

paragraphs.summary: F 段首句說，組織程序和主動控制鼠疫的初步嘗試，始於 1727–1728 年 Astrakhan 疫情之後。末句說由信使帶來的信件，要先在火上加熱，再被抄寫。首尾句顯示本段主題是防疫程序正式化。中間提到帝國當局發布法令，要求省長即時通報 Senate、檢查疑似感染者、隔離、設置檢查站、焚燒房屋財物、通知鄰省和處理信件。
paragraphs.label: Section F

paragraphs.summary: G 段只有一句，說當局實施這些 combined measures，展示了他們對「及時隔離感染者可以限制鼠疫傳播」有直覺式理解。只看這句，可以知道本段是全文總結，不提供新例子。它把前文多種措施收束成一個核心防疫原則：及早發現、及早隔離、限制人和物品移動。雖然 G 段不在 heading題範圍內，但有助理解文章總方向。
paragraphs.label: Section G

paragraphs.summary: Questions 20–21 的 B / D 可互換次序；Questions 22–23 的 A / E 可互換次序。 Step 3：逐題分析Question 14答案：ii — Systematic intelligence-gathering about external cases of plague題目要求：為 Section A 選最合適 heading。中文意思：找出 A 段整段主旨。題型與任務：Matching Headings。Heading 題要看整段反覆處理的核心，不要只抓一個細節。這段最明顯的重複概念是 information、reported、commercial channels、military personnel、undercover agents、embassies、customs offices。 Skim：目標段落：Section A第一句：“In the second half of the seventeenth century, Russian authorities began implementing controls at the borders of their empire to prevent the importation of plague, a highly infectious
paragraphs.label: 26 fire

paragraphs.summary: 中文意思：在十七世紀下半葉，俄羅斯當局開始在帝國邊境實施管制，以防止鼠疫這種高度傳染和危險的疾病輸入。最後一句：“For instance, the heads of customs offices were instructed to question foreigners entering Russia about possible epidemics of dangerous diseases in their respective countries.”中文意思：例如，海關主管被指示要詢問進入俄羅斯的外國人，了解他們各自國家是否可能有危險疾病流行。只看首尾句，A 段先講邊境管制目的，最後講海關詢問外國人疫情情況。中間應會解釋俄羅斯如何知道外國是否有疫情。 Scan：題目 heading ii 的定位詞是 “intelligence-gathering” 和 “external cases”。原文沒有intelligence-gathering 這個詞，但有 “Information on disease outbreaks occurring abroad was regularly reported”。external cases = outbreaks occurring abroad。 Read：關鍵句是：“Information on disease outbreaks occurring abroad was regularly reported to the tsar’s court
paragraphs.label: and dangerous disease.”

paragraphs.summary: 中文意思：發生在國外的疾病爆發資訊，會透過不同方式定期報告到沙皇宮廷。後面列出的方式包括 travelling merchants、military personnel deployed abroad、undercover agents、Imperial Foreign Office embassies、customs offices。這些渠道合起來就是 systematic intelligence-gathering。heading ii 覆蓋整段，因為它不只包含密探，也包含外交、軍事、商業和海關渠道。錯項方面，iii “Early forms of treatment” 完全沒有治療內容；v “bans against foreign states” 更適合 B 段，因為 B 段才講 suspend relations、vessels not allowed to dock、quarantine。A 段的重點是外國疫情資訊如何被收集和上報。所以答案是 ii。 Question 15答案：v — Partly successful bans against foreign states affected by plague題目要求：為 Section B 選最合適 heading。中文意思：判斷 B 段主要內容。題型與任務：Matching Headings。這段有很多防疫措施，但整段最突出的主線是：收到外國疫情消息後，俄羅斯限制與受影響國家的接觸，並且短期看來有效。 Skim：目標段落：Section B第一句：“If news of an outbreak came from abroad, relations with the affected country were suspended.”中文意思：如果從國外傳來疫情爆發的消息，俄羅斯就會中止與受影響國家的關係。最後一句：“By the end of the seventeenth century, preventive measures had been widely introduced in Russia, including the isolation of persons ill with plague, the imposition of quarantines, and the distribution of explanatory public health notices about plague outbreaks.”中文意思：到十七世紀末，俄羅斯已廣泛引入預防措施，包括隔離鼠疫病人、實施檢疫，以及發布解釋鼠疫爆發情況的公共衛生告示。只看首尾句，可以知道本段從中止對外關係開始，收束到十七世紀末預防措施普及。中間會有具體禁令和效果例子。 Scan：heading v 的關鍵是 “bans”、“foreign states affected by plague” 和 “partly successful”。原文對應包括 “relations ... were suspended”、“foreign vessels were not allowed to dock”、“all foreigners ... had to undergo quarantine”，以及 “appeared to have been effective”。 Read：關鍵證據：“For instance, foreign vessels were not allowed to dock in Russian ports if there was credible information about the existence of epidemics in countries from whence they had departed.”中文意思：例如，如果有可信資料顯示船隻出發國有疫情，外國船隻就不得停靠俄羅斯港口。“In 1665 ... Tsar Alexei ... announced the cessation of Russian trade relations with England and
paragraphs.label: through various means...”

paragraphs.summary: 中文意思：1665 年，在收到英國鼠疫消息後，沙皇 Alexei 宣布中止俄羅斯與英國及其他外國的貿易關係。“These protective measures appeared to have been effective...”中文意思：這些保護措施看來有效。“appeared to have been effective” 支援 heading 中的 successful；但後文又提 1692 年Astrakhan 爆發鼠疫，所以 heading 用 “partly successful” 很精準，表示措施有成效，但未能永久阻止鼠疫再出現。錯項 vi “Hostile reactions from foreign states” 沒有原文支援；B 段只說俄羅斯中止關係，沒有說外國抗議或敵對反應。viii “formulation and publication of preventive strategies” 更適合 F 段的decrees 和 Instructions。所以答案是 v。 Question 16答案：i — Outbreaks of plague resulting from military campaigns題目要求：為 Section C 選 heading。中文意思：找出 C 段主旨。題型與任務：Matching Headings。這段表面有很多地名和年份，但主線是十八世紀鼠疫如何在戰爭和軍事部署中出現，並造成俄軍重大損失。 Skim：目標段落：Section C第一句：“During the eighteenth century, although none of the outbreaks was of the same scale as in the past, plague appeared in Russia several times.”中文意思：十八世紀期間，雖然沒有任何一次疫情達到過去那種規模，鼠疫仍數次出現在俄羅斯。最後一句：“Russian military chronicles of the time note that more soldiers died of the disease after the capture of Riga than from enemy fire during the siege of that city.”中文意思：當時俄羅斯軍事編年史記載，在攻佔 Riga 後，死於疾病的士兵多於在圍城期間死於敵方炮火的士兵。首句帶出十八世紀疫情多次出現，末句聚焦軍隊死亡。這提示 C 段的重心會落在 plague 和military campaigns 的關係。 Scan：heading i 的定位詞是 “military campaigns”。原文出現 battle of Poltava、dispatched part of his army、Russian troops、besieged Riga、Russian army lost 9,800 soldiers。這些都是軍事語義場。 Read：關鍵句包括：“After defeating the Swedes in the battle of Poltava in 1709, Tsar Peter I ... dispatched part of his army to Poland, where plague had been raging for two years.”中文意思：1709 年在 Poltava 戰役擊敗瑞典人後，Peter I 派出部分軍隊前往波蘭，而鼠疫已在波蘭肆虐兩年。“Despite preventive measures, the disease spread among the Russian troops.”中文意思：儘管有預防措施，疾病仍在俄軍中傳播。“...the Russian army lost 9,800 soldiers to the plague.”中文意思：俄軍有 9,800 名士兵死於鼠疫。這些句子說明疫情和軍隊移動、圍城、戰爭部署密切相連。heading i 用 “resulting from military campaigns” 概括這一段最貼切。錯項 vii 也有 “war”，但它說的是 “Various measures to limit outbreaks”，更像 D 段，因為 D 段列出隔離、軍營分隔、封鎖和路障。C 段重點在 outbreak 和 casualties。所以答案是 i。 Question 17答案：vii — Various measures to limit outbreaks of plague associated with war題目要求：為 Section D 選 heading。中文意思：判斷 D 段主旨。題型與任務：Matching Headings。D 段和 C 段都涉及戰爭，所以要分清：C 段講戰事導致或伴隨疫情；D 段講如何在戰事中限制疫情。 Skim：目標段落：Section D第一句：“Tsar Peter I imposed strict measures to prevent the spread of plague during these conflicts.”中文意思：Peter I 在這些衝突期間實施嚴格措施，以防止鼠疫擴散。最後一句：“The tsar’s orders were rigorously enforced, and those who disobeyed were hanged.”中文意思：沙皇的命令被嚴格執行，違令者會被絞死。首句已經直接說 strict measures to prevent the spread；末句說執行非常嚴厲。這段功能明顯是列舉戰時防疫措施。 Scan：heading vii 的定位詞是 “measures”、“limit outbreaks” 和 “war”。原文對應 “imposed strict measures”、“isolated”、“separate divisions”、“cordon off”、“roadblocks and checkpoints”。 Read：關鍵證據：“Soldiers suspected of being infected were isolated and taken to areas far from military camps.”中文意思：疑似感染的士兵會被隔離，並帶到遠離軍營的地方。“In addition, camps were designed to separate divisions, detachments, and smaller units of soldiers.”中文意思：此外，軍營設計會分隔師、支隊和較小士兵單位。“...roadblocks and checkpoints were set up on all roads.”中文意思：所有道路都設置路障和檢查站。這些措施共同目的都是限制人員與物資流動，減低戰爭期間鼠疫擴散。heading vii 的 “various measures” 能覆蓋隔離、軍營設計、河界封鎖、暫停活動、路障和檢查站。錯項 i 與軍事有關，但 i 更重在 outbreaks caused by campaigns；D 段核心是 prevention and control。iv “general limitations” 要到 E 段，因為 E 段以 However 開始評估措施缺陷。所以答案是 vii。 Question 18答案：iv — The general limitations of early Russian anti-plague measures題目要求：為 Section E 選 heading。中文意思：找出 E 段整體功能。題型與任務：Matching Headings。E 段很短，轉折詞 However 是主旨訊號。這段不再列新措施，焦點轉向早期措施的不足。 Skim：目標段落：Section E第一句：“However, although the Russian authorities applied such methods to contain the spread of the disease and limit the number of victims, all of the measures were provisional...”中文意思：然而，雖然俄羅斯當局使用這些方法控制疾病傳播並限制受害者人數，但所有措施都只是臨時性的。最後一句：“The advent of such a standard response system came a few years later.”中文意思：這種標準應對系統的出現，要到數年後才發生。首句講 provisional，末句講 standard response system 後來才出現。這組首尾句清楚顯示：前面的措施有用，但缺乏標準化、系統化。 Scan：heading iv 的定位詞是 “limitations” 和 “early measures”。原文對應 “all of the measures were provisional”、“not designed as a coherent set of measures”、“implemented systematically”。 Read：關鍵句：“...they were intended to respond to a specific outbreak, and were not designed as a coherent set of measures to be implemented systematically at the first sign of plague.”中文意思：這些措施旨在回應某一次具體疫情，並沒有被設計成一套連貫措施，能在鼠疫初現時系統地執行。這句直接說明 limitations：措施只針對單次疫情，缺乏 coherence 和 systematic implementation。 heading iv 的 “general limitations” 正好概括此段。錯項 viii “formulation and publication of preventive strategies” 看似也有 standard response system，但 E 段說這套系統還未出現。真正 formulation 在 F 段，因為 F 段講 issued several decrees 和 Instructions。所以答案是 iv。 Question 19答案：viii — The formulation and publication of preventive strategies題目要求：為 Section F 選 heading。中文意思：判斷 F 段主旨。題型與任務：Matching Headings。F 段是全文中最長的一段，列出具體法令和程序。Heading 要能覆蓋整段，不可只抓 burn houses 或 heat letters 等細節。 Skim：目標段落：Section F第一句：“The first attempts to organise procedures and carry out proactive steps to control plague date from the aftermath of the 1727–1728 epidemic in Astrakhan.”中文意思：組織程序並採取主動措施控制鼠疫的初步嘗試，始於 1727–1728 年 Astrakhan 疫情之後。最後一句：“Finally, letters brought by couriers were heated above a fire before being copied.”中文意思：最後，由信使帶來的信件要先在火上加熱，再被抄寫。首句已經顯示程序化和主動防控；末句是其中一項具體程序。整段會列出官方策略的內容。 Scan：heading viii 的定位詞是 “formulation”、“publication” 和 “preventive strategies”。原文對應“issued several decrees”、“Instructions for Governors and Heads of Townships”、“required that...”。 Read：關鍵證據：“In response to this, the Russian imperial authorities issued several decrees aimed at controlling the future spread of plague.”中文意思：作為回應，俄羅斯帝國當局發布了幾項法令，目的在於控制日後鼠疫的傳播。“Among these decrees, the ‘Instructions for Governors and Heads of Townships’ required that all governors immediately inform the Senate...”中文意思：在這些法令中，《給省長和城鎮主管的指示》要求所有省長在各自省份發現鼠疫病例時，立即通知 Senate。接著原文列出檢查、隔離、檢查站、焚燒房屋財物、通知鄰近省市、加熱信件等程序。這些都屬於preventive strategies 的具體內容。heading viii 最能概括整段。錯項 iii “treatment for plague victims” 不合適，因為 F 段重點是通報、隔離、封鎖和處理物品，沒有講醫療治療。iv 則是 E 段的限制評估。所以答案是 viii。
paragraphs.label: other foreign states.”
